_note: Per-platform posting cadence used when a social-media-manager draft is approved in the review UI. See social-publisher.js. `media` is an array of public-URL strings (relative to baseUrl) used for IG/Pinterest payloads. The first entry on Pinterest is the pin; the full list on Instagram is the carousel.

instagram._disabled_reason: Defaulting off until owner confirms typography placeholder is the right creative direction. Flip enabled:true to start posting these on Mon/Wed/Fri 14:00 UTC.

pinterest._disabled_reason: Defaulting off until owner confirms typography placeholder is the right creative direction. Flip enabled:true to start daily 14:00 UTC pinning.
